## 4:31 (overlap: 12%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | For thus declares YHWH concerning cosmic upheaval: "I-YHWH have-spoken; it-shall-come-to-pass." |
| LOGOS | For thus declares the LORD concerning cosmic upheaval: "I the LORD have spoken; it shall come to pass." |
| PNEUMA | This is the LORD's declaration about cosmic upheaval: "I, the LORD, have spoken — and it will happen." |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
